parameters.query: SELECT 'leads' as metric, COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score >= 70) as qualified, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verified = true) as verified FROM leads UNION ALL SELECT 'outreach', COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) FROM outreach_emails UNION ALL SELECT 'prospects', COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_maker_score >= 7), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'contacted') FROM prospects UNION ALL SELECT 'linkedin_posts', COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'published'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'draft') FROM linkedin_posts UNION ALL SELECT 'meetings', COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'booked'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') FROM meeting_requests
